text:
elaine: Heads-up — did a quick pass on the in-product docs panel and found three things we should triage: dark-mode focus invisibility, anchor deep-links not scrolling reliably, and a copy mismatch for model pinning. Putting notes here so we can prioritize before the console release.

sam: thanks! can you paste a quick repro for the focus issue? i couldn't hit that locally.

elaine: repro: open console in dark mode, open a help panel from the model details page, then tab through until you reach the first link. outline is nearly invisible (same color as bg) so keyboard users lose position.

mike: ah, yeah — happening because we override :focus with a 1px ring that uses --bg-elev. dark mode uses the same token so contrast is gone. easy fix is to change to a permanent high-contrast ring on :focus-visible.

jordan: add to that: the panel traps focus but doesn't announce the close button to some screen readers — aria-labels are present but the dialog role isn't consistent across routes. i can write a quick patch.

olivia: on copy: console says "Pin model" while docs site uses "Freeze version". product wants consistent language since customers get confused during rollouts. i'd vote for "Pin model version" (explicit).

sam: +1 to being explicit. can we run a quick A/B in the console? maybe track clicks on the pin CTA to see which wording reduces support pings.

docs-bot: shared: docs PR #1423 updates canonical term to "Pin model version" and adds redirect anchors for older links: https://docs.redwood.ai/concepts/pinning -> /pinning.

elaine: thanks — follow-ups: (1) set focus-visible ring color to var(--accent-contrast) in dark mode, (2) ensure the help panel has role=dialog and aria-modal when opened from model routes, (3) change CTA copy and add analytics event 'help_panel_pin_cta_clicked'.

mike: for (2) i found a small bug in our overlay manager — when opening from nested routes we skip calling attachTrap(). patch idea:

mike: ```js
// quick patch idea
const panel = openHelpPanel(opts);
panel.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
panel.addEventListener('keydown', onTrapTab);
panel.focus();
```

jordan: looks good. i'll add an automated axe check for dialog semantics in the e2e suite so this doesn't regress.

olivia: related: deep links from docs that are like https://docs...#pinning currently open the console but don't scroll the panel to the anchor. maybe our anchor IDs differ (docs use "pinning" vs console uses "pin-model").

elaine: yeah that's the mismatch. docs PR uses redirects but console should normalize anchors on open. pseudocode: if (anchor && !findAnchor(anchor)) try alias map -> ['pinning','pin-model','freeze-version'] then scrollIntoView.

sam: can we also track which alias gets used so docs+console teams can consolidate? analytics event like 'help_anchor_resolved' with label of resolved_alias.

docs-bot: noted — added analytics ticket: ENG-4312 (track help panel anchors + CTA wording clicks).

aria-bot: accessibility note: ensure focus order preserves visual order when we auto-scroll to anchors. otherwise screen readers can end up focused on an offscreen node. use element.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) before focusing.

olivia: quick mock posted: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/help-panel-anchor-flow (see notes about skip link and contrast).

elaine: next steps: jordan/mike -> patch for dialog semantics + focus ring (low effort), olivia -> update anchor alias map and copy change, sam -> wire analytics event. aim for patch and docs sync before next deploy (this week).

mike: i'll open a draft PR and tag you all. expect a tiny CSS + 20-line TS change.

jordan: i'll add the axe test and a keyboard smoke test in the e2e.

olivia: i'll land the copy change in the console i18n file and coordinate with docs-bot for the canonical redirect.

sam: love it. can we add a short note to release notes about the accessibility fix and the copy harmonization? customers in gov sectors will appreciate it.

elaine: good call. i'll draft the release blurb after PRs are merged. :thumbsup: 

olivia: thanks everyone — tagging @eng-oncall to be aware of the small overlay change in case it impacts running sessions.

mike: ping when PR is up.

elaine: PRs: #2048 (focus + dialog), #2049 (anchor aliases + copy), #2050 (analytics). closing out here — will move tasks into the sprint board.
